web.26:15: Look down from your holy habitation, from heaven, and bless your people Israel, and the ground which you have given us, as you swore to our fathers, a land flowing with milk and honey.”
web.26:16: Today Yahweh your God commands you to do these statutes and ordinances. You shall therefore keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.
web.26:17: You have declared today that Yahweh is your God, and that you would walk in his ways, keep his statutes, his commandments, and his ordinances, and listen to his voice.
web.26:18: Yahweh has declared today that you are a people for his own possession, as he has promised you, and that you should keep all his commandments.
web.26:19: He will make you high above all nations that he has made, in praise, in name, and in honor; and that you may be a holy people to Yahweh your God, as he has spoken.
web.27:1: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep all the commandment which I command you today.
web.27:2: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat them with plaster.
web.27:3: You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have passed over, that you may go in to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as Yahweh, the God of your fathers, has promised you.
web.27:4: It shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.
web.27:5: There you shall build an altar to Yahweh your God, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them.
web.27:6: You shall build Yahweh your God’s altar of uncut stones. You shall offer burnt offerings on it to Yahweh your God.
web.27:7: You shall sacrifice peace offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before Yahweh your God.
web.27:8: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly.”
web.27:9: Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, “Be silent and listen, Israel! Today you have become the people of Yahweh your God.
web.27:10: You shall therefore obey Yahweh your God’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”
web.27:11: Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,
web.27:12: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.
web.27:13: These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.
web.27:14: With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel,
web.27:15: ‘Cursed is the man who makes an engraved or molten image, an abomination to Yahweh, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ All the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen.’
web.27:16: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
web.27:17: ‘Cursed is he who removes his neighbor’s landmark.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
web.27:18: ‘Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
web.27:19: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
web.27:20: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his father’s wife, because he dishonors his father’s bed.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
web.27:21: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
web.27:22: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
web.27:23: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
web.27:24: ‘Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
web.27:25: ‘Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
web.27:26: ‘Cursed is he who doesn’t uphold the words of this law by doing them.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’ ”
web.28:1: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that Yahweh your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.
web.28:2: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.
web.28:3: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.
web.28:4: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.
web.28:5: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.
web.28:6: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.
web.28:7: Yahweh will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way, and will flee before you seven ways.
web.28:8: Yahweh will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. He will bless you in the land which Yahweh your God gives you.
web.28:9: Yahweh will establish you for a holy people to himself, as he has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of Yahweh your God, and walk in his ways.
web.28:10: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by Yahweh’s name, and they will be afraid of you.
web.28:11: Yahweh will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers to give you.
web.28:12: Yahweh will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.
web.28:13: Yahweh will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of Yahweh your God which I command you today, to observe and to do,
web.28:14: and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.
web.28:15: But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you today, that all these curses will come on you and overtake you.
web.28:16: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.
web.28:17: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.
web.28:18: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.
web.28:19: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.
web.28:20: Yahweh will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.
web.28:21: Yahweh will make the pestilence cling to you, until he has consumed you from off the land where you go in to possess it.
web.28:22: Yahweh will strike you with consumption, with fever, with inflammation, with fiery heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew. They will pursue you until you perish.
web.28:23: Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.
web.28:24: Yahweh will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.
web.28:25: Yahweh will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.
web.28:26: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.
web.28:27: Yahweh will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.
web.28:28: Yahweh will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.
web.28:29: You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you.
web.28:30: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.
web.28:31: Your ox will be slain before your eyes, and you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face, and will not be restored to you. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you.
web.28:32: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look, and fail with longing for them all day long. There will be no power in your hand.
web.28:33: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always,
web.28:34: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.
web.28:35: Yahweh will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.
web.28:36: Yahweh will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods of wood and stone.
web.28:37: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where Yahweh will lead you away.
web.28:38: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.
web.28:39: You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat them.
web.28:40: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won’t anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives will drop off.
web.28:41: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.
web.28:42: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.
web.28:43: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower.
web.28:44: He will lend to you, and you won’t lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.
web.28:45: All these curses will come on you, and will pursue you and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you didn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.
web.28:46: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.
web.28:47: Because you didn’t serve Yahweh your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;
web.28:48: therefore you will serve your enemies whom Yahweh sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of all things. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.
web.28:49: Yahweh will bring a nation against you from far, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language you will not understand,
web.28:50: a nation of fierce facial expressions, that doesn’t respect the elderly, nor show favor to the young.
web.28:51: They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave you grain, new wine, oil, the increase of your livestock, or the young of your flock, until they have caused you to perish.
web.28:52: They will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down throughout all your land. They will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land which Yahweh your God has given you.
web.28:53: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom Yahweh your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you.
web.28:54: The man who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining,
web.28:55: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates.
web.28:56: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves, toward her son, toward her daughter,
web.28:57: toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates.
web.28:58: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, YAHWEH your God,
web.28:59: then Yahweh will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration, and severe sicknesses, and of long duration.
web.28:60: He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.
web.28:61: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, Yahweh will bring them on you until you are destroyed.
web.28:62: You will be left few in number, even though you were as the stars of the sky for multitude, because you didn’t listen to Yahweh your God’s voice.
web.28:63: It will happen that as Yahweh rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so Yahweh will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you. You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess.
web.28:64: Yahweh will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. There you will serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers, even wood and stone.
web.28:65: Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but Yahweh will give you there a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and pining of soul.
web.28:66: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.
web.28:67: In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the fear of your heart which you will fear, and for the sights which your eyes will see.
web.28:68: Yahweh will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I told to you that you would never see it again. There you will offer yourselves to your enemies for male and female slaves, and nobody will buy you.
web.29:1: These are the words of the covenant which Yahweh commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.
web.29:2: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that Yahweh did in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land;
web.29:3: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.
web.29:4: But Yahweh has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.
web.29:5: I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not grown old on you, and your sandals have not grown old on your feet.
web.29:6: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink, that you may know that I am Yahweh your God.
web.29:7: When you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle, and we struck them.
web.29:8: We took their land, and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.
web.29:9: Therefore keep the words of this covenant and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.
web.29:10: All of you stand today in the presence of Yahweh your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,
web.29:11: your little ones, your wives, and the foreigners who are in the middle of your camps, from the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water,
web.29:12: that you may enter into the covenant of Yahweh your God, and into his oath, which Yahweh your God makes with you today,
web.29:13: that he may establish you today as his people, and that he may be your God, as he spoke to you and as he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.
web.29:14: Neither do I make this covenant and this oath with you only,
web.29:15: but with those who stand here with us today before Yahweh our God, and also with those who are not here with us today
web.29:16: (for you know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the middle of the nations through which you passed;
web.29:17: and you have seen their abominations and their idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold, which were among them);
web.29:18: lest there should be among you man, woman, family, or tribe whose heart turns away today from Yahweh our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that produces bitter poison;
web.29:19: and it happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, “I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart,” to destroy the moist with the dry.
web.29:20: Yahweh will not pardon him, but then Yahweh’s anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse that is written in this book will fall on him, and Yahweh will blot out his name from under the sky.
web.29:21: Yahweh will set him apart for evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this book of the law.
web.29:22: The generation to come—your children who will rise up after you, and the foreigner who will come from a far land—will say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses with which Yahweh has made it sick,
web.29:23: that all of its land is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, doesn’t produce, nor does any grass grow in it, like the overthrow of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, which Yahweh overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath.
web.29:24: Even all the nations will say, “Why has Yahweh done this to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?”
web.29:25: Then men will say, “Because they abandoned the covenant of Yahweh, the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt,
web.29:26: and went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods that they didn’t know and that he had not given to them.
web.29:27: Therefore Yahweh’s anger burned against this land, to bring on it all the curses that are written in this book.
web.29:28: Yahweh rooted them out of their land in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation, and thrust them into another land, as it is today.”
web.29:29: The secret things belong to Yahweh our God; but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may do all the words of this law.
web.30:1: It shall happen, when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations where Yahweh your God has driven you,
web.30:2: and return to Yahweh your God and obey his voice according to all that I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,
web.30:3: that then Yahweh your God will release you from captivity, have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the peoples where Yahweh your God has scattered you.
web.30:4: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there Yahweh your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back.
web.30:5: Yahweh your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good, and increase your numbers more than your fathers.
web.30:6: Yahweh your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your offspring, to love Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.
web.30:7: Yahweh your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.
web.30:8: You shall return and obey Yahweh’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.
web.30:9: Yahweh your God will make you prosperous in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, for good; for Yahweh will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers,
web.30:10: if you will obey Yahweh your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law; if you turn to Yahweh your God with all your heart and with all your soul.
web.30:11: For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant.
web.30:12: It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”
web.30:13: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, “Who will go over the sea for us, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”
web.30:14: But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.
web.30:15: Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.
web.30:16: For I command you today to love Yahweh your God, to walk in his ways and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, that you may live and multiply, and that Yahweh your God may bless you in the land where you go in to possess it.
web.30:17: But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away and worship other gods, and serve them,
web.30:18: I declare to you today that you will surely perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it.
web.30:19: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants,
web.30:20: to love Yahweh your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that you may dwell in the land which Yahweh swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.
web.31:1: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.
web.31:2: He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. Yahweh has said to me, ‘You shall not go over this Jordan.’
web.31:3: Yahweh your God himself will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua will go over before you, as Yahweh has spoken.
web.31:4: Yahweh will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when he destroyed them.
web.31:5: Yahweh will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.
web.31:6: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them; for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
web.31:7: Moses called to Joshua, and said to him in the sight of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you shall go with this people into the land which Yahweh has sworn to their fathers to give them; and you shall cause them to inherit it.
web.31:8: Yahweh himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.”
web.31:9: Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, and to all the elders of Israel.
web.31:10: Moses commanded them, saying, “At the end of every seven years, in the set time of the year of release, in the feast of booths,
web.31:11: when all Israel has come to appear before Yahweh your God in the place which he will choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.
web.31:12: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little ones, and the foreigners who are within your gates, that they may hear, learn, fear Yahweh your God, and observe to do all the words of this law,
web.31:13: and that their children, who have not known, may hear and learn to fear Yahweh your God, as long as you live in the land where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”
web.31:14: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, your days approach that you must die. Call Joshua, and present yourselves in the Tent of Meeting, that I may commission him.” Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the Tent of Meeting.
web.31:15: Yahweh appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the Tent’s door.
web.31:16: Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers. This people will rise up and play the prostitute after the strange gods of the land where they go to be among them, and will forsake me and break my covenant which I have made with them.
web.31:17: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall come on them; so that they will say in that day, ‘Haven’t these evils come on us because our God is not among us?’
web.31:18: I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evil which they have done, in that they have turned to other gods.
web.31:19: “Now therefore write this song for yourselves, and teach it to the children of Israel. Put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.
web.31:20: For when I have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they have eaten and filled themselves, and grown fat, then they will turn to other gods, and serve them, and despise me, and break my covenant.
web.31:21: It will happen, when many evils and troubles have come on them, that this song will testify before them as a witness; for it will not be forgotten out of the mouths of their descendants; for I know their ways and what they are doing today, before I have brought them into the land which I promised them.”
web.31:22: So Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the children of Israel.
web.31:23: He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, “Be strong and courageous; for you shall bring the children of Israel into the land which I swore to them. I will be with you.”
web.31:24: When Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,
web.31:25: Moses commanded the Levites, who bore the ark of Yahweh’s covenant, saying,
web.31:26: “Take this book of the law, and put it by the side of the ark of Yahweh your God’s covenant, that it may be there for a witness against you.
web.31:27: For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. Behold, while I am yet alive with you today, you have been rebellious against Yahweh. How much more after my death?
web.31:28: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to witness against them.
web.31:29: For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn away from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will happen to you in the latter days, because you will do that which is evil in Yahweh’s sight, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.”
web.31:30: Moses spoke in the ears of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, until they were finished.
web.32:1: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.
web.32:2: My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the showers on the herb.
web.32:3: For I will proclaim Yahweh’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!
web.32:4: The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.
web.32:5: They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.
web.32:6: Is this the way you repay Yahweh, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you and established you.
web.32:7: Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.
web.32:8: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.
web.32:9: For Yahweh’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.
web.32:10: He found him in a desert land, in the waste howling wilderness. He surrounded him. He cared for him. He kept him as the apple of his eye.
web.32:11: As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young, he spread abroad his wings, he took them, he bore them on his feathers.
web.32:12: Yahweh alone led him. There was no foreign god with him.
web.32:13: He made him ride on the high places of the earth. He ate the increase of the field. He caused him to suck honey out of the rock, oil out of the flinty rock;
web.32:14: butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.
web.32:15: But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned God who made him, and rejected the Rock of his salvation.
web.32:16: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.
web.32:17: They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods that they didn’t know, to new gods that came up recently, which your fathers didn’t dread.
web.32:18: Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.
web.32:19: Yahweh saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.
web.32:20: He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.
web.32:21: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will move them to jealousy with those who are not a people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.
web.32:22: For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the foundations of the mountains on fire.
web.32:23: “I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them.
web.32:24: They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I will send the teeth of animals on them, with the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.
web.32:25: Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.
web.32:26: I said that I would scatter them afar. I would make their memory to cease from among men;
web.32:27: were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, lest their adversaries should judge wrongly, lest they should say, ‘Our hand is exalted, Yahweh has not done all this.’ ”
web.32:28: For they are a nation void of counsel. There is no understanding in them.
web.32:29: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
web.32:30: How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and Yahweh had delivered them up?
web.32:31: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.
web.32:32: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.
web.32:33: Their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.
web.32:34: “Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?
web.32:35: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides; for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom rushes at them.”
web.32:36: For Yahweh will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone; that there is no one remaining, shut up or left at large.
web.32:37: He will say, “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge;
web.32:38: which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.
web.32:39: “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand.
web.32:40: For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,
web.32:41: if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will repay those who hate me.
web.32:42: I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the leaders of the enemy.”
web.32:43: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his adversaries, and will make atonement for his land and for his people.
web.32:44: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.
web.32:45: Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel.
web.32:46: He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.
web.32:47: For it is no vain thing for you, because it is your life, and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”
web.32:48: Yahweh spoke to Moses that same day, saying,
web.32:49: “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel for a possession.
web.32:50: Die on the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people;
web.32:51: because you trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you didn’t uphold my holiness among the children of Israel.
web.32:52: For you shall see the land from a distance; but you shall not go there into the land which I give the children of Israel.”
web.33:1: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
web.33:2: He said, “Yahweh came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands of holy ones. At his right hand was a fiery law for them.
web.33:3: Yes, he loves the people. All his saints are in your hand. They sat down at your feet. Each receives your words.
web.33:4: Moses commanded us a law, an inheritance for the assembly of Jacob.
web.33:5: He was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, all the tribes of Israel together.
web.33:6: “Let Reuben live, and not die; Nor let his men be few.”
web.33:7: This is for Judah. He said, “Hear, Yahweh, the voice of Judah. Bring him in to his people. With his hands he contended for himself. You shall be a help against his adversaries.”
web.33:8: About Levi he said, “Your Thummim and your Urim are with your godly one, whom you proved at Massah, with whom you contended at the waters of Meribah.
web.33:9: He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know his own children; for they have observed your word, and keep your covenant.
web.33:10: They shall teach Jacob your ordinances, and Israel your law. They shall put incense before you, and whole burnt offering on your altar.
web.33:11: Yahweh, bless his skills. Accept the work of his hands. Strike through the hips of those who rise up against him, of those who hate him, that they not rise again.”
web.33:12: About Benjamin he said, “The beloved of Yahweh will dwell in safety by him. He covers him all day long. He dwells between his shoulders.”
web.33:13: About Joseph he said, “His land is blessed by Yahweh, for the precious things of the heavens, for the dew, for the deep that couches beneath,
web.33:14: for the precious things of the fruits of the sun, for the precious things that the moon can yield,
web.33:15: for the best things of the ancient mountains, for the precious things of the everlasting hills,
web.33:16: for the precious things of the earth and its fullness, the good will of him who lived in the bush. Let this come on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who was separated from his brothers.
web.33:17: Majesty belongs to the firstborn of his herd. His horns are the horns of the wild ox. With them he will push all the peoples to the ends of the earth. They are the ten thousands of Ephraim. They are the thousands of Manasseh.”
web.33:18: About Zebulun he said, “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and Issachar, in your tents.
web.33:19: They will call the peoples to the mountain. There they will offer sacrifices of righteousness, for they will draw out the abundance of the seas, the hidden treasures of the sand.”
web.33:20: About Gad he said, “He who enlarges Gad is blessed. He dwells as a lioness, and tears the arm and the crown of the head.
web.33:21: He provided the first part for himself, for the lawgiver’s portion reserved was reserved for him. He came with the heads of the people. He executed the righteousness of Yahweh, His ordinances with Israel.”
web.33:22: About Dan he said, “Dan is a lion’s cub that leaps out of Bashan.”
web.33:23: About Naphtali he said, “Naphtali, satisfied with favor, full of Yahweh’s blessing, Possess the west and the south.”
web.33:24: About Asher he said, “Asher is blessed with children. Let him be acceptable to his brothers. Let him dip his foot in oil.
web.33:25: Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.
web.33:26: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies.
web.33:27: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’
web.33:28: Israel dwells in safety, the fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine. Yes, his heavens drop down dew.
web.33:29: You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by Yahweh, the shield of your help, the sword of your excellency? Your enemies will submit themselves to you. You will tread on their high places.”
web.34:1: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is opposite Jericho. Yahweh showed him all the land of Gilead to Dan,
web.34:2: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the Western Sea,
web.34:3: and the south, and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, to Zoar.
web.34:4: Yahweh said to him, “This is the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’ I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there.”
web.34:5: So Moses the servant of Yahweh died there in the land of Moab, according to Yahweh’s word.
web.34:6: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day.
web.34:7: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.
web.34:8: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.
web.34:9: Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. The children of Israel listened to him, and did as Yahweh commanded Moses.
web.34:10: Since then, there has not arisen a prophet in Israel like Moses, whom Yahweh knew face to face,
web.34:11: in all the signs and the wonders which Yahweh sent him to do in the land of Egypt, to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land,
web.34:12: and in all the mighty hand, and in all the awesome deeds, which Moses did in the sight of all Israel.
